evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; the growth stage requires tube pressure, so the atmosphere cannot be fully verified
Ramp followed setpoint; small overshoot to 760 at 2520 s, then steady at 750 ±1 °C with Pheat about 45%
Ar steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint
Purge brought O2 down to about 5 ppm and it stayed at 3.5–7 ppm through growth, which argues against an air leak

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure readings, from an installed gauge or a manual check, to rule out an exhaust blockage or pressure change the O2 and flow sensors cannot detect. Characterization of the sample after the run.
